court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court No.5, Bandra, Mumbai, Petition No.B-32 of 2010
case_name: Tony Marcel Fernandes vs Zulekha Tony Fernandes
facts_of_case: The parties got married according to Hindu Vedic rites and registered their marriage under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. They have a daughter who was about 13 years old at the time of filing the petition. The Appellant's petition for divorce and custody of the child Michelle was dismissed by the trial court.

legal_principles.principle: The principle of res judicata applies when the cause of action is the same and all averments are one and the same.
legal_principles.held: It was observed that all the averments in the earlier petition and the petition filed before him were one and the same, and therefore, the cause of action was also the same.

legal_principles.principle: A Family Court has exclusive jurisdiction to decide on the validity of a marriage and matrimonial status.
legal_principles.held: Under Section 7(1) Explanation (b) of the Family Courts Act, 1984, a suit or a proceeding for a declaration as to the validity of both marriage and matrimonial status of a person is within the exclusive jurisdiction of the Family Court.
cited_cases: Balram Yadav Vs. Fulmaniya Yadav, (Year) X SCC Y
